g.text: Why prop drilling is a problem:

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: if the application size increases, it becomes messy and hard to maintain.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 1. Cluttered code - every immediate component has to inherit the unnecessary props.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2. Hard to Maintain - if we add or remove a prop this has to be updated at every level

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 3. Reduced Readability - its hard to see which component actually utilized the prop

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 4. Performance Issues - re-rendering will occur unnecessarily.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
